[b][color=white]EW IMG MyCode[/color][/b]
IMG MyCode tag has been enabled for EW Section. [i][size=x-small][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6007278]>>Source[/url][/size][/i]

[b][color=white]HF Convos Link Poll[/color][/b]
Give your suggestions/Opinions about the Conversation Feature. What should happen when the conversation link is clicked. [i][size=x-small][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6008548]>>Source[/url][/size][/i]

[b][color=white]Paid Bytes Bump (PBB)[/color][/b]
To reduce the LQP (Low-Quality Posts) and increase the use of Bytes PBB (Paid Bytes Bump) has been introduced. Now, members can Bump their threads for a fee of small Bytes. [i][size=x-small][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6011110]>>Source[/url][/size][/i]

[b][color=white]Mobile Navigation Changes[/color][/b]
The mobile navigation view has been altered to make it more user-friendly. [i][size=x-small][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6010874]>>Source[/url][/size][/i]

[b][color=white]HF SportsBook Now Open[/color][/b]
Now members can bet on Sports using HF Bytes. [i][size=x-small][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6012753]>>Source[/url][/size][/i]

[b][color=white]New Award Goals[/color][/b]
24k and Sportsbook award has been added to the Award Goals. [i][size=x-small][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6013287]>>Source[/url][/size][/i]

[b][color=white]Convo Pruning[/color][/b]
Give your feedback on Convo Pruning. Vote for, at what intervals do you want Pruning to happen. [i][size=x-small][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6014385]>>Source[/url][/size][/i]

[b][color=white]PBB Price Increase[/color][/b]
Due to excessive usage of PBB. The price for PBB has been increased. [i][size=x-small][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6014336]>>Source[/url][/size][/i]

[b][color=white]Profile Analytics[/color][/b]
Now you can see your HF 28 days period stats. [i][size=x-small][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6015418]>>Source[/url][/size][/i]
